items.source: Implementation of R2dbcEntityOperations. It simplifies the use of Reactive R2DBC usage through entities and helps to avoid common errors. This class uses DatabaseClient to execute SQL queries or updates, initiating iteration over Result.
items.translation: 实现R2dbcEntityOperations接口。它通过实体简化了响应式 R2DBC 的使用，并有助于避免常见错误。该类使用DatabaseClient执行 SQL 查询或更新操作，并启动对Result的迭代。

items.source:
Upserts the given entity, specifically insert if the row with the given identifier does not exist or update
otherwise. The identifier must be already assigned. Only supported when the dialect supports single-statement
upsert.
items.translation: 将给定的实体进行 Upsert 操作：如果具有给定标识符的行不存在，则插入；否则更新。该标识符必须已分配。仅当方言支持单语句 Upsert 时才受支持。
